body.description: LinkedIn ad account, fetched by numeric id (one request per id in LINKEDIN_AD_ACCOUNT_IDS). Recovery probe plus currency source for ad_account.currency; AAP 0.3.3. Transcribed from the 'Fetch Ad Account' section and Schema table of the served Learn moniker li-lms-2026-09 (updated 2026-09-16). A 401 or 403 on this call classifies LinkedIn as access-denied and switches all of LinkedIn to simulated (AAP 0.3.3). Undeclared keys fail validation, so a field a newer version adds must be declared here from the page once a live capture shows it.

id.description: Unique internal account id (long); the {id} of the request path.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO code; amounts on campaigns, groups and analytics are in this currency. Default USD. An account in BRL sees budgets, bids and spend in BRL but is billed in USD.

status.description: Default ACTIVE. CANCELED is permanent; DRAFT is not yet set up and not serving; PENDING_DELETION is a requested deletion; REMOVED is deleted but still fetchable because performance data exists.

type.description: BUSINESS is the only value the API can create; ENTERPRISE is reserved for accounts created by LinkedIn's internal ad operations.

reference.description: Entity on whose behalf the account advertises: urn:li:person:{id} or urn:li:organization:{id}.

referenceInfo.description: Union info record for the reference (OrganizationInfo for an organization, PersonInfo for a person, otherwise an empty record). Read-only, and returned only when requested as an Additional Info Field.

originatingCustomer.description: Optional URN urn:li:customer:{id} of the customer that originated the account's order. ENTERPRISE accounts only, set at creation and immutable. Supported from API version 202608.

productType.description: Optional source product type inherited by every campaign under the account. ENTERPRISE accounts only, set at creation and immutable. Supported from API version 202608.

servingStatuses.description: System serving statuses. Exactly [RUNNABLE] when the account can serve; otherwise one or more reasons it cannot. Default [].

notifiedOnCampaignOptimization.description: Campaign contact is notified of optimization opportunities. Default false.

notifiedOnCreativeApproval.description: Creative contact is notified when a creative is approved. Default false.

notifiedOnCreativeRejection.description: Creative contact is notified when a creative is rejected. Default false.

notifiedOnEndOfCampaign.description: Campaign contact is notified when a campaign completes. Default false.

notifiedOnNewFeaturesEnabled.description: Account owner is notified of new Campaign Manager features. Default false.

test.description: Test account flag. Settable only at creation and immutable. Default false.

changeAuditStamps.description: Creation and last-modification stamps. time is epoch milliseconds; actor is optional, because the page's search sample omits it.

actor.description: URN of the actor, for example urn:li:person:{id} or urn:li:unknown:0.
